output.review_comment: The implementation includes special-case logic for p=50 with even-count arrays (averaging two middle values) that contradicts the docstring's claim to implement nearest-rank method throughout. This looks like test-specific logic added to satisfy particular tests rather than a coherent algorithm design. Request: 1) Clarify the docstring to explicitly state that median (p=50) uses interpolation for even-count arrays while other percentiles use nearest-rank, OR 2) Redesign to use a consistent algorithm throughout. The change from "values are never averaged" to averaging medians needs clear documentation of why this special case exists.
